description: Canonical source-policy definitions for the rain-push v7 corpus contract. Single source of truth for all corpus enums and per-layer / per-evidence-level capabilities. Code MUST read enums and capabilities from this file (see lib/source-policy.mjs) and MUST NOT hardcode them, so the vocabulary and the policy stay code-as-documentation and cannot drift between validator, migrator, exporter and scanner.

C1.label: canon
C1.meaning: Official primary text (in-app dialogue, official script). Authoritative for character behavior, wording and mechanics.

C2.label: guide
C2.meaning: Strategy guide / walkthrough. Mechanics only — thresholds, routes, triggers. Must NOT drive persona wording or behavior primitives.

C3.label: community
C3.meaning: Community / fan material. Language fingerprint context only. Must NOT influence behavior or mechanics.

C4.label: extension
C4.meaning: Simulator / synthetic extension. Test-only. Excluded from generation and from public export.

A.meaning: Channel, event, state and surrounding context are clear.

B.meaning: The sentence itself reveals the main trigger and function.

D.meaning: Fragment, transcription, placeholder, duplicate or context-insufficient. Excluded — must not directly drive generation.

unverified.meaning: Provenance not yet verified. Usable but flagged.

suspected_ai.meaning: Suspected AI-generated / contaminated. Quarantined — must not influence anything.
